title: FastFighting D&D 5e
description: Dungeons & Dragons Fifth Edition support for FastFighting Core: reads dnd5e weapons, spells and features through their activities (attacks, saves, damage, healing and the conditions their effects impose), Multiattack and Extra Attack, Sneak Attack and Pack Tactics, resistances, immunities and vulnerabilities, languages and social skills; plays 5e turns (action, bonus action and movement), advantage and disadvantage, critical hits and death saves; and commits outcomes back to dnd5e actors with Make it So.
